main_idea: Warmup lifts Nemotron 3 Ultra's GDPval score most of the way to the teacher.
ideas: Warmup closes most of the gap to the teacher
Warmup raises GDPval score over no warmup
Student and teacher bound the comparison
summary: Clean chart with a clear finding; the two-line headline could be shortened, and the graphic lacks units and a definition of what Student, Teacher, and Warmup mean.

missing.why: Axis says GDPVAL SCORE but not whether it is a percent or Elo-type value.
Student and teacher are not defined; reader cannot tell what the starting and reference models are.
Warmup vs no warmup is not explained, so the compared condition is unclear to a non-reader.
